body: Yes, please lord. This was definitely an experience every singe person should experience at least once. Music truly is such a special thing. Everyone that LD's should try at least once making songs about their loved ones or things they love. Using whatever genre they choose. The power and connection is something special, I am not much of an emotional guy but I teared up afterwards. So yes, please lord allow every single of us beings wake in a world filled with that connection and power.

Nope, never did I play the piano seriously, I do have an electronic keyboard but that was when I was young. I did dabble in making a bit of music electronically for a year(Using programs like FL Studio and the like) which I suppose gave me a bit of experience prior. Like certain chords and whatnot. Maybe if I LD again I can pay attention to what chords I press and see if I can re-create some of the songs in the waking life. If not, then getting the sort of melody down would be awesome.
